findings.title: enchanted-library/page.tsx divides by zero when computing result payload
findings.evidence: correctAnswers: Math.floor(results.xp / results.accuracy) and totalAttempts: Math.floor(results.xp / results.accuracy / results.accuracy) are unguarded. accuracy can be 0.

findings.title: Game page tests fail in jsdom because fetch is not mocked
findings.evidence: pnpm jest --testPathPatterns='games/vocabulary/(magic-defense|rpg-battle|rune-match|wizard-vs-zombie)/page.test.tsx' -> Test Suites: 4 failed, 4 total; Tests: 11 failed, 1 passed, 12 total. All failures trace to 'fetch is not defined'.

findings.title: rpg-battle/page.tsx contains domain/business logic that belongs in backend modules
findings.evidence: Page defines battle constants, damage calculation, turn management, XP scaling, crit chance, and TTS directly in a React component.

findings.title: history/page.tsx and lesson/[articleId]/page.tsx forward raw request headers to internal API calls
findings.evidence: fetchData forwards headers() wholesale; lesson/page.tsx also passes headers() to internal /api/v1/classroom/students/${user.id}.

findings.title: magic-defense/page.tsx stale-closure / missing dependency on t
findings.evidence: useEffect uses t('notEnoughWords') but dependency array is [setVocabulary].

findings.title: rune-match/page.tsx imports useRouter but never uses it
findings.evidence: import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation' is unused; router.push('/') is commented out.

findings.title: wizard-vs-zombie/page.tsx imports dynamic but never uses it
findings.evidence: import dynamic from 'next/dynamic' is unused; WizardZombieGame is imported statically.

findings.title: wizard-vs-zombie/page.tsx multiplies accuracy by 100 before sending, unlike other games
findings.evidence: accuracy: results.accuracy * 100 while other game pages send 0-1 decimal.

findings.title: lesson/[articleId]/page.tsx displays raw API response in CustomError
findings.evidence: Returns <CustomError message={articleResponse.message} resp={articleResponse} />; custom-error.tsx renders JSON.stringify(resp).

findings.title: lesson/[articleId]/page.tsx and history/page.tsx use any for transformed records
findings.evidence: history/page.tsx uses record: any and article: any; lesson/page.tsx casts articleResponse?.article as Article.

findings.title: layout.tsx function name is SettingsPageLayout but it is the student layout
findings.evidence: export default async function SettingsPageLayout in student/layout.tsx.

findings.title: layout.tsx expired-date comparison can behave unexpectedly with empty string
findings.evidence: new Date(user?.expired_date) < new Date() with empty string yields Invalid Date comparison.

findings.title: Game pages hardcode English fallback text and error copy
findings.evidence: User-facing strings and TTS lang='en-US' are not routed through next-intl.

findings.title: rpg-battle/page.tsx ActionMenu receives menuActions without translation
findings.evidence: menuActions strips translation field; player must type translation but UI only shows term.

findings.title: goals/page.tsx ignores locale and hardcodes English metadata/heading
findings.evidence: Page accepts no params and uses English literals for metadata and heading.

findings.title: lesson/[articleId]/custom-error.tsx and read/[articleId]/custom-error.tsx are duplicates
findings.evidence: Files are byte-identical.

findings.title: lesson/[articleId]/error.tsx and read/[articleId]/error.tsx are duplicates
findings.evidence: Files are byte-identical.

findings.title: lesson/[articleId]/loading.tsx and read/[articleId]/loading.tsx are duplicates
findings.evidence: Files are byte-identical.

findings.title: history/loading.tsx uses fixed pixel widths that may overflow on small screens
findings.evidence: w-[400px] and w-[500px] without max-width or responsive classes.

findings.title: Game pages use console.log/console.error instead of structured logging
findings.evidence: Multiple console.error/console.log calls for fetch and save errors.

findings.title: rpg-battle/page.tsx hardcodes TTS language to en-US
findings.evidence: utterance.lang = 'en-US'; // Assume English terms for now

findings.title: rpg-battle/page.tsx crit chance uses unseeded Math.random()
findings.evidence: if (Math.random() > 0.8) { spawnFloatingText('CRITICAL!', ...) }

A3.evidence: No bare-digit regex assertions in the 20 files.

A4.evidence: Game page tests fail rather than pass vacuously; no marker-consistency checks in scope.

A5.evidence: Four game page .test.tsx files describe rendering/vocabulary behavior but 11/12 tests fail with 'fetch is not defined'.

A6.evidence: No track registry claims were reviewed in this batch.

A9.evidence: No references to measure/tracks/ found in the 20 files.

A11.evidence: Parent track plan is already marked complete.

test_execution.root_cause: fetch is not defined in jsdom; tests mock visual game components but not the vocabulary fetch.

test_gaps: No tests for goals/page.tsx, history/page.tsx, layout.tsx, lesson/[articleId]/page.tsx, or read/[articleId]/ shell files.
Existing game page tests do not cover loading, error, fetch success, game completion payload, difficulty selection, or rankings reload.
caveats: This review did not remediate app code; it produced audit artifacts only.
next.config.mjs has ignoreBuildErrors: true, so TypeScript/build gates are not meaningful for these files.
Only the 20 listed files were reviewed; dependent components and API routes were inspected only for context.
No browser/UX manual validation was performed.
